scope: Independent read-only review of native capability/reward audit source, original frozen tasks/protocol, tests and completed actual report; no model loading, training, new GPU job or source mutation

mathematical_contract.loss: -(1/G) sum_i A_i (sum_t m_it logpi(y_it|x,y_i,<t)/L_i), inclusive group mean/population std and detached advantages
mathematical_contract.head_gradient: For each token, A_i*m_it/(G*L_i) times (p_it−onehot(y_it)) outer detached hidden state; signs match minimization of negative reward-weighted log probability
mathematical_contract.sampler: Existing collector draws unfiltered full-vocabulary softmax at temperature1; no topk/topp/answer grammar. First natural stop enters mask and likelihood; forced padded EOS after termination is excluded
mathematical_contract.precision: Actual parent/head clone/hidden matmul is BF16; logits/logsoftmax use FP32, head-weight backward is represented in the clone's dtype, and returned gradient is cast to FP32 for aggregation. No full-FP32-gradient claim
mathematical_contract.alignment: Reported alignment checks head projection versus full model teacher-forced old-policy scoring. It does not independently attest bitwise equality to every generation-step kernel distribution
mathematical_contract.reach: Detached-hidden output-weight subspace only. Tied embedding/transformer pathways and KL gradients are excluded; no optimizer exists in this audit
mathematical_contract.independent_tests: CPU Qwen random fixture matches manually accumulated softmax outer products; constant0/1 rewards give exactzero; mismatched likelihood rejects; gate requires both splits and aggregate nonzero norm

ancestry.boundary: This cached native Qwen root is distinct from the compatible random-init CPU SFT/sibling chain and from historical trained native descendants; future same-parent SFT/RL remains unexecuted

accounting.failure_contract: Decode exceptions yield strictreward0 and explicit ERROR rows, retained in requested/completed denominators. Unsupported/invalid parser outcomes remain rows. Collector/load exceptions preserve partial attempt counters through finally/atomic flush and stop; uncollected count remains separate. No retry or discarded-group selection

interpretation.accepted: No usable task-relative update signal under this frozen strict reward/extraction interface; absence is the actual diagnostic result
interpretation.arithmetic_boundary: All48 richer grades are UNSUPPORTED, so0 richer-correct is not established0 arithmetic capability. EOS texts visibly contain correct-looking equations/answers, such as2+3=5,−7+2=−5 and(3+4)*2=14, that these extraction contracts reject. Preserve strings/statuses; no silent parser relaxation or hindsight reward substitution
interpretation.future: No same-parent SFT/RL pilot was executed or justified by this failed signal gate

corpus_preflight_applicability.decision: Existing explicit whole-fixture split audit, immutable fixture hash, independent tests and notebook checkpoint4 before checkpoint6 are sufficient for this actual bounded lesson acceptance. No source edit or duplicate preflight infrastructure is necessary
corpus_preflight_applicability.api_boundary: learning_reference accepts a custom fixture path and does not itself promise to run the source/near-duplicate preflight. TrainingSession rejects IDs and normalized-exact text overlap only. A future changed fixture must rerun existing duplicate_audit+split_audit before interpreting training; an optional convenience call can reuse these functions rather than invent a second validator
